newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of East Asia sets HK$2.6 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bank of East Asia sets HK$2.6 bln FRCD.

text.p: Bank of East Asia's HK$2.6 billion floating rate certificate of deposite issue is now in general syndication, bookrunner Societe Generale Asia said Thursday.
The issue size has been increased to HK$2.6 billion from HK$2.5 billion after the formation of an arranger group, it said.
